faq.q: Can I build a fourplex on my Brookswood lot?
faq.a: Possibly — under Bylaw No. 6020 (adopted November 18, 2024), an eligible lot (inside the Urban Containment Boundary, on municipal water and sewer, no heritage designation, not in a Transit Oriented Area, 4,050 m² or smaller) permits 4 units if it is over 280 m² and 3 units at 280 m² or smaller. There is no 6-unit tier in the Township, whatever a listing or guide says about transit-adjacent lots.

The Brookswood-Fernridge Community Plan, with the Booth, Fernridge and Rinn Neighbourhood Plans under it; the Township states the plan allows previously undeveloped areas to grow while protecting trees and watercourses.

faq.q: Is a Brookswood property in the ALR?
faq.a: Some Township properties are in the Agricultural Land Reserve and some are not; check the exact parcel on the Agricultural Land Commission map and in the Township's GeoSource before making any development assumption — ALC rules permit one additional residence on ALR land only within its size caps and subject to Township bylaws.

faq.q: How do I find out which school serves an address in Brookswood?
faq.a: School catchments are set by address, so use the school district's catchment locator with the exact address. Catchment lines change, so check before you write an offer.
